entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery `@ start()` modifier requires query range context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: the query endpoints always lower through LowerAtRange with the request window, so range context is present. Cerberus issue #2581 added two new callers, lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubqueryFoldFn and lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubquerySelectFn (histogram_native_mixed_or_subquery_aggregate_range_fn.go) — both reached only from the same query-endpoint entry points as every other caller in this list, so the claim is unaffected.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: the PromQL parser yields only START, END, or zero in StartOrEnd. Cerberus issue #2581 added two new callers, lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubqueryFoldFn and lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubquerySelectFn (histogram_native_mixed_or_subquery_aggregate_range_fn.go), both threading the same parser-produced SubqueryExpr through unchanged, so the claim is unaffected.

guard: default of switch e.StartOrEnd over [case parser.START; case parser.END; case 0; default]
